description.en: Starts an NPC's reaction to being talked to and returns its reaction type (0 to 3, from the NPC's data). With type 2 the NPC starts looking at the speaker; with type 1 a stored look setting of the NPC is applied, and the NPC talk script also turns the NPC to face the player. CMND_TALK_END ends it.

The reaction type, 0 to 3 (0 if the NPC is not found).
null if the script system is not ready or no argument is given.

examples.case: Talking to an NPC (real usage, from ev43010000.nut)
